No cross-category dedup hits (checked all 3 product URLs against cross_category_url_index.json, all null - moot since none qualify for rows anyway). Conclusion: confirmed absence of a genuine Bathroom category on this site; it is a garden/outdoor decor brand with only two incidental washbasin/sink products with no supporting category infrastructure.
